title: H Bridge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: H
learningObjectives: Identify the four switches, the positive and negative power rails, and the DC motor that form the H shape of the circuit
Trace the current path from the positive rail through the motor to the negative rail for the Forward and Reverse states
Explain why closing the upper-left and lower-right switches reverses motor rotation compared with closing the upper-right and lower-left pair
Predict the motor behavior when all four switches are open in the Stop state
Evaluate why closing both switches on the same side of the H would short the supply rails
